title: Preparing for a work-experience placement
instructions: Write in English in connected paragraphs. Complete all the requested points. Task 1 requires at least 150 words. Complete the separate Task 2 essay with at least 250 words.

stimulus.text:
Task 1
You will soon spend three months gaining work experience in an organisation. You have not met its manager. Write a letter to the manager. In your letter:
• thank the manager for the opportunity
• explain what you hope to learn during the placement
• ask questions about the work experience so that you can prepare.
Begin your letter: Dear Sir or Madam,
Write at least 150 words in connected paragraphs. You do not need to write any addresses. Aim to spend about 20 minutes. Use a formal style.

Task 2
People can pay others to do household tasks or provide care when they have little time or do not want to do these tasks themselves. Is this a useful way to create work for others? Should people instead carry out these responsibilities themselves?
Give reasons for your answers and relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words in connected paragraphs. Aim to spend about 40 minutes.

questions.prompt: Write your letter. Develop every part of all three bullet points and write at least 150 words.
Write a separate essay answering both questions in Task 2. Write at least 250 words.

criteria.label: Task achievement — Task 1
criteria.description: For Task 1 only: clear letter purpose, appropriate formal relationship and register, and sufficiently developed, relevant coverage of every component in the three bullet points. Do not replace the requested function with a related but different one; at least 150 words.

criteria.label: Task response — Task 2
criteria.description: For Task 2 only: address both stated questions with clear, developed answers and relevant support. Evaluate the employment benefit of paying others and whether people should do the responsibilities themselves; neither answer may be assumed from the other. Write at least 250 words.

criteria.label: Coherence and cohesion
criteria.description: Assess logical progression, purposeful paragraphs and clear referencing/linking within each response; avoid mechanical connector counts.

criteria.label: Lexical resource
criteria.description: Assess accurate, appropriate vocabulary and collocation, flexibility of expression and the effect of spelling or word-formation errors in each response.

criteria.label: Grammatical range and accuracy
criteria.description: Assess control of simple and complex structures, sentence boundaries and punctuation, with attention to errors that obscure meaning in each response.

assessment.feedbackGuidance: After submission only: Private annotated letter snippets, after submission only: “Thank you for offering me the opportunity to gain experience with your organisation.” directly acknowledges the opportunity. “I hope to learn how the team turns a client’s initial request into a completed project.” gives a concrete learning goal. “Could you let me know which team I will join and whether I should complete any preparation beforehand?” asks more than one relevant practical question. These are optional details, not a fixed answer. Private essay snippet: “Paying for a task can create work for someone with suitable skills, but that benefit does not decide whether every household should outsource it.” separates the employment question from the responsibility question. Map all three bullet functions to actual learner spans and identify any missing component. Separate missing content from vague development or inappropriate register. Explain one useful paragraphing choice, one lexical choice and one grammar issue with evidence; ask the learner to revise an underdeveloped point and an unclear sentence, then explain the revisions. Do not require these exemplar details, memorised text, real contact details or a fixed greeting/closing formula beyond the task. No band, score, calibrated estimate or official examiner claim. Review q1 and q2 separately: Task achievement for the letter, Task response for the essay; Coherence and cohesion, Lexical resource and Grammatical range and accuracy apply separately to each. The essay must develop answers to both stated questions, with reasons and relevant examples. Do not convert the two practice responses into a combined Writing score.

locale.instructionsFa: به انگلیسی و در بندهای پیوسته بنویسید. همهٔ موارد نامه را پاسخ دهید و دست‌کم ۱۵۰ واژه بنویسید. مقالهٔ جداگانهٔ بخش دوم را با دست‌کم ۲۵۰ واژه کامل کنید.
